L107: M Countdown Chart winners (2023)
L108: ---
L109: The M Countdown Chart is a 【38†record chart】 on the South Korean 【39†Mnet】 【40†television music program】 【41†M Countdown】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【42†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.
L110: In 2023, 25 singles ranked number one on the chart and 17 music acts received first-place trophies. "【43†Fighting】" by 【44†Seventeen BSS】 received the highest score of the year, with 10,669 points, on the February 16 broadcast. Six songs have collected trophies for three weeks and achieved a 【45†Triple Crown】: "【43†Fighting】" by 【44†Seventeen BSS】, "【46†Take Two】" by 【47†BTS】, "【48†Seven】" and "【49†3D】" by 【50†Jungkook】, "【51†Love Me Again】" and "【52†Slow Dancing】" by 【53†V】.

L124: 【56†BSS】 (pictured) won their first M Countdown trophy and their first Triple Crown for "【43†Fighting】."
L125: 
L126: 【57†Le Sserafim】 (top), and 【58†Enhypen】 (bottom) won their first M Countdown trophy with "【59†Unforgiven】," and "Bite Me," respectively.
L127:

L129: 【64†Blackpink】's 【65†Jisoo】 (pictured) won her first M Countdown trophy as a soloist with her song "【66†Flower】". Key
